source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 836 introduces canUpdate gates for online state, data-policy notification version and enabled notifications, then connects the updater callback before init. The fixed accepted source separates readyToUpdate from online eligibility and can fall back to default offline notifications. These gates govern downloading and startup cache use; they are not equivalent to per-notification targeting. No network fetch, policy transition or offline startup ran.
title: Separate notification download eligibility from cache selection
